title: A Special $Π^0_1$ Class with the Join Property but without Pseudojump Inversion
summary: Jananthan and Simpson showed that special $Π^0_1$ classes exist in three of the four possible cases determined by whether the Join Property and the Pseudojump Inversion Property hold, leaving open the existence of a special $Π^0_1$ class with the Join Property but not the Pseudojump Inversion Property. We construct such a class, thereby answering their question affirmatively and completing the four-way existence pattern. Moreover, the class can be chosen to consist entirely of generalized low reals, with the Join Property holding locally on every nonempty relatively basic open subclass. More…
